package queryfields

import (
	"sort"
	"strings"
)

// Allowed defines a set of field names available for query-time selection.
type Allowed map[string]struct{}

// Set represents a validated set of fields requested by the client.
type Set struct {
	fields  map[string]struct{}
	all     bool
	allowed Allowed
}

// AllowedFields defines which fields can be requested for each entity type.
var (

		"slug",
		"title",
		"description",

		"tags",

		"lesson_count",
	)

	CourseAllowedFields = allowed(

	)

func allowed(names ...string) Allowed {
	set := make(Allowed, len(names))
	for _, name := range names {
		set[strings.ToLower(name)] = struct{}{}
	}
	return set
}

// Parse parses comma-separated field names and validates them against the allowed set.
// If input is empty or contains no valid fields, the returned set means "all allowed fields".
func Parse(input string, allowed Allowed) Set {
	s := Set{
		allowed: allowed,
		fields:  make(map[string]struct{}),
	}

	input = strings.TrimSpace(input)
	if input == "" {
		s.all = true
		return s
	}

	parts := strings.Split(input, ",")
	for _, part := range parts {
		name := strings.TrimSpace(strings.ToLower(part))
		if name == "" {
			continue
		}
		if _, ok := allowed[name]; ok {
			s.fields[name] = struct{}{}
		}
	}

	if len(s.fields) == 0 {
		s.all = true
	}

	return s
}

// IsAll returns true if all allowed fields were requested.
func (s Set) IsAll() bool {
	return s.all
}

// Has reports whether the field is part of the validated set.
func (s Set) Has(name string) bool {
	name = strings.ToLower(name)
	if s.all {
		_, ok := s.allowed[name]
		return ok
	}
	_, ok := s.fields[name]
	return ok
}

// Including returns a copy that also selects the named allowed fields. It is
// used when a handler needs an identifier internally but must still honor the
// client's response projection.
func (s Set) Including(names ...string) Set {
	copySet := Set{
		fields:  make(map[string]struct{}, len(s.fields)+len(names)),
		all:     s.all,
		allowed: s.allowed,
	}
	for name := range s.fields {
		copySet.fields[name] = struct{}{}
	}
	if copySet.all {
		return copySet
	}
	for _, name := range names {
		name = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(name))
		if _, ok := copySet.allowed[name]; ok {
			copySet.fields[name] = struct{}{}
		}
	}
	return copySet
}

// Names returns the requested field names sorted for stable query generation.
func (s Set) Names() []string {
	var names []string
	if s.all {
		for name := range s.allowed {
			names = append(names, name)
		}
	} else {
		for name := range s.fields {
			names = append(names, name)
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(names)
	return names
}
